title: [Expense Agent] Initialize missing vendor numbering after upgrade
summary: A per-company upgrade initializes missing vendor number series for the Expense Agent, ensuring merchant-driven expense creation works after upgrades when defaults were applied but vendor numbering remained blank.
key_points: Adds a tagged per-company upgrade step to the existing upgrade codeunit that fills only blank Expense Vendor Nos. values
Vendor-only initializer preserves configured number series and existing counters
Repairs the same missing value through default settings and the setup wizard
Enables the default-settings action when the vendor numbering field is empty
Adds tests for upgrade, number series preservation and merchant expense creation (not yet run per the description)
quote: Existing companies can have default number series marked as applied while Expense Vendor Nos. remains blank.
